title: Comparison Trial Between Two Repellent Products and a Positive Control Against Culicoides Nubeculosus Midges
brief_summary: Comparison trial between two repellent products and a positive control against Culicoides nubeculosus midges. A single-centre laboratory setting study using healthy volunteers to test two insect repellent products and a positive control product against Culicoides nubeculosus midges. The test products are designed for use by the general public in areas where midge biting is likely.
